text_block_list.text: In another universe, the one who took "that throne" was the "Hero". But in this universe—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe!!
Achieving this year's Senior Autumn Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's all good, Universe-chan!
Ah~ I'm frustrated! But somehow, super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A Starship, huh? Haha, I dunno, but it was like she was floating right over the waves!

The congratulations of her rivals.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san... congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy,
Neo Universe is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Tugging back and forth with you, I did "achieve".
However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You've truly become the "Usurper"...
Snatching away Zenno Rob Roy's golden crown...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What do you think is
the difference between the "strong" and a "hero"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "strong" and... a "hero"...
...Unknown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Here's what I think.
A "strong person" is simply someone who is strong.
While a "hero" is...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: They say they're the kind of person legends are told about.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Handed down... through generations...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san told me. That at this rate,
I won't be able to leave behind my sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I can't leave anything behind, that means... I won't be able
to become the hero I envisioned.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This was for the best!
I truly believe this is the storyline I've always dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
For showing me the path to becoming an even greater hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please let me challenge you again next year!
I'll definitely surpass you, Uni, and become the Autumn Senior Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “You're right. In order for Neo Universe to lead them to a “habitable planet”...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I'll be here. Always... by your side. A hero's side is where 'Neo Uni' truly belongs, after all.

The two smiled at each other. The glory they achieved
turned into starlight—
It illuminated the boundlessly stretching future of the two.
